## Objective

Bai–Perron analysis evaluates whether the mean level of the analytical
ICVLF exhibits statistically identifiable structural changes.

It does **not** identify the causal source of those changes.

## Confidence intervals

The model retains:

- estimated break date;
- lower 95% confidence bound;
- upper 95% confidence bound;
- approximate interval width.

The raw `confint()` structure is also stored in the master RDS for
auditability because software output structures can vary.

::: {.callout-warning}

A break date should not be labeled as the effect of a particular
regulatory reform, macroeconomic shock or policy intervention without a
separate causal research design.

:::
